monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral repair-or-replace workflow that takes a purchase-ready reader through exact model and part identity, six compatibility layers, three-candidate evidence, delivered ownership cost, checkout gates, return rights, and a valid manufacturer-service, retirement, or no-purchase outcome. No merchant, product, price, rating, discount, stock claim, fabricated test, or product image was added.

image_qa.note: Both new pages use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. No health, patient, product, replacement-part, merchant, stock, generated, or ambiguous exact-model image was introduced, and no existing image was changed.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is one day old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.36% CTR, and average position 20.69. Arkansas at ten impressions and position 10.2 was already materially reinforced November 12; Blue Dream's 48-impression family was already materially reinforced November 17. The only remaining product signals—510 versus disposable and trimming scissors—had two impressions each, while Delaware had two impressions and one click. Those rows were deliberately ignored as too weak, already served, or insufficient to justify another cluster variation. The report's canonical-sitemap error prompted live and generated-file verification, not filler content: the current sitemap is valid and reachable, while stale Search Console submissions require property-owner cleanup. No content item is labeled Data-led today; analytics protected diversity and focused the technical verification.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready health evidence library that connects urgent-care, medicines, population, condition, product, and claim-verification lanes to current CDC, NCCIH, and FDA entry points and to established Big Bud Man guides through reciprocal contextual links. Added a public, executable source-review freshness contract to the editorial policy and release audit. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; the asset itself and its transparent sourcing were the higher-value authority action.
